messages:
sam: Heads-up — CI on master is red intermittently on RetryHandlerTest.restarts_on_backoff. Fails ~1/10 runs. Link: https://ci.example.com/build/4821. Error is \"expected 1 restart, got 0\". Can someone triage?
ci-bot: Build 4821 failed: tests/runtime/test_retry_handler.py::RetryHandlerTest::restarts_on_backoff. Repro rate: ~10%. Logs: https://ci.example.com/build/4821/logs. Rerun button available.
maya: Ugh, that one smells like timer/jitter nondet. Can you try local repro with TEST_SEED and disabling xdist? e.g. `TEST_SEED=17291 pytest tests/runtime/test_retry_handler.py::RetryHandlerTest::restarts_on_backoff -q`
dave: Also try `-n0` to avoid xdist interleaving. Adding sleeps in tests just masks the flake, but as a quick check you can add `await clock.advance(50ms)` if we use fake clock.
ling: I can kick off a bisect job across HEAD~40..HEAD with a seed sweep. Command I'll use: `./scripts/bisect_flake --test tests/runtime/test_retry_handler.py::RetryHandlerTest::restarts_on_backoff --commits HEAD~40..HEAD --seeds 1000..1020` — will post results here when done.
alex: I ran the local repro with seed 17291 (same as maya example). Repro'd in ~3 runs. Minimal local command I used:
```
TEST_SEED=17291 pytest tests/runtime/test_retry_handler.py::RetryHandlerTest::restarts_on_backoff -q
```
Log snippet: "assert restarts == 1, got 0; backoff timer fired earlier than expected" — looks like race between cancel and schedule. I'm pushing a tiny test patch that pins the clock to deterministic fake clock for that test.
sam: Thanks Alex. Hold merges for now — I'll mark the PR as "do not merge" until we validate Alex's patch. If Alex's patch fixes CI, we can follow up with a proper runtime fix.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by sam for build 4821. New run queued: build/4822.
maya: If bisect finds a specific commit, we can hotfix quickly. If it's seed-sensitive, we should add TEST_SEED logging to the test to catch future flakes automatically.
dave: Agree. Also add `CI_SEED` to the junit artifact metadata so the dashboard shows reproducible seed on failure.
ling: Bisect job started — initial results will take ~45m (range 40 commits x ~5 seeds each). Posting progress here.
alex: Patch pushed to branch `fix/retry-test-clock` — uses FakeClock and awaits stable state before asserting. Ran locally with 100 random seeds, no repro.
sam: Awesome. Maya/dave/ling — can one of you kick CI once Alex's patch is merged and confirm green? I'll remove DNM once green. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: build/4822 completed: green (after Alex's patch) — tests passed.
sam: Moving to close — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a small runtime issue to track the underlying race.
__note: This file is a single Slack thread string following agents.md constraints.
